evals.prompt:
Implement a structural runtime-audit, redaction, and dynamic-construction library in `audit_reflect.titan` (logical module `audit_reflect`) using Titan's standard `reflect` module.

Export the following public functions:
- `function exact_tag(v: value): string`: inspects `v` via `reflect.inspect(v)` (preserving exact runtime tags such as `3` -> `"integer"` vs `3.0` -> `"float"`) and returns one of the 19 canonical tag strings: `"nil"`, `"integer"`, `"float"`, `"boolean"`, `"string"`, `"array"`, `"const_array"`, `"map"`, `"record"`, `"union"`, `"interface"`, `"titan_function"`, `"lua_function"`, `"lua_c_function"`, `"owned_foreign_pointer"`, `"owned_foreign_array"`, `"lua_userdata"`, `"lua_thread"`, or `"raw_pointer"`.
- `function describe_type(t: reflect.Type): string`: inspects `t` with `case` (never `==` or Map keys) and formats:
  - scalars: `"nil"`, `"boolean"`, `"integer"`, `"float"`, `"string"`, `"value"`
  - `is_option(inner)`: `describe_type(inner) .. "?"`
  - `is_array(constness, elem)`: `"{" .. elem .. "}"` for mutable, `"const {" .. elem .. "}"` for const, `"const? {" .. elem .. "}"` for maybe-const
  - `is_map(k, v)`: `"{" .. describe_type(k) .. ": " .. describe_type(v) .. "}"`
  - `is_named(nt)`: `"named:" .. nt.name`
  - `is_record(r)` / `is_union(u)` / `is_interface(i)`: `"record:" .. r.name`, `"union:" .. u.name`, `"interface:" .. i.name`
  - `is_function(ft)`: `"function(" .. #ft.param_descriptors .. ")->" .. #ft.return_descriptors`
  - any foreign/C variant: `"foreign"`.
- `function resolve_nominal_kind(fqtn: string): string`: queries initialized modules via `reflect.find_nominal(fqtn)` (preserving `nil`) and returns `"missing"`, `"record"`, `"union"`, or `"interface"`.
- `function inspect_erased_field(v: value, field_name: string): (string, string, string?)`: inspects record `v`, finds public field `field_name` in `rec.type.fields[1..rec.n_fields]` (raising if `v` is not a record or the field is missing), and returns `(rec.type.name, describe_type(field.type), resolved_kind?)`. When `field.type` is `is_named(nt)`, resolve it one step (`nt:resolve()`) and set `resolved_kind?` to `"record"`, `"union"`, `"interface"`, or `"value"`; otherwise `nil`.
- `function redact_string_fields(target: value, keys: const? {string}, replacement: string): integer`: inspects record `target` (raising if not a record), iterates 1-based public ordinals `1..rec.n_fields` (never 0-based `FieldType.index`), and for every public field whose name appears in `keys`, is **not** `const`, and currently holds a `string` value (checked on `rec:get(i)`), replaces it via `rec:set(i, replacement)`. Returns the count of mutated fields.
- `function can_direct_construct(v: value): boolean`: inspects `v`; returns `true` for `is_record(rv)` only when **both** `rv.type.is_public` and `rv.type.all_public` are `true` (and similarly for `is_union(uv)`), returning `false` otherwise.
- `function construct_record_smart(fqtn: string, args: const {value}): value`: looks up `fqtn` via `reflect.find_nominal(fqtn)` (raising if missing or not a record). If `rt.is_public and rt.all_public`, constructs directly via `rt:construct(args)` (initializing `const` fields directly without calling `new`). Otherwise obtains `rt:public_constructor()` (raising if `nil`) and invokes `ctor.callable(...args)` returning the constructed record.
- `function describe_union_value(v: value): (string, integer, string?, integer)`: inspects union `v` (raising otherwise), matches `uv.tag` against `uv.type.variants` by `variant.tag` (not list position assumption), and returns `(uv.type.name, uv.tag, matched_variant_name?, uv.n_parts)`—returning `nil` for the name when an active `local` variant arm is held without crashing.
- `function construct_public_variant(fqtn: string, variant_name: string, parts: const {value}): value`: looks up public union `fqtn`, finds the public variant with matching `name`, and constructs it via `ut:construct(variant.tag, parts)`.

assertions.check: Uses `reflect.inspect(v)` preserving exact runtime tags (`3` -> `integer` vs `3.0` -> `float`), and indexes `RecordValue:get`/`set` strictly by 1-based public ordinal `1..rec.n_fields` (never 0-based `FieldType.index`), skipping `const` fields safely.

Preserves `nil` on `reflect.find_nominal(fqtn)` (`local found?`), inspects `reflect.Type` exclusively via `case` (never `==`/Map keys), and handles erased generic descriptors (`T`/`T?` -> `is_value`, constrained `T: I` -> `is_named` resolving to `is_interface`).

Checks BOTH `is_public` and `all_public` before calling `RecordType:construct`, falls back to `RecordType:public_constructor()` for records with `local` fields, matches `UnionValue.tag` via `VariantType.tag`, and handles active `local` union arms cleanly.

evals.judge_rubric: Canonical provenance: `titan-reflect` (`inv-1..inv-6`, `value-type-quick-map`, `field-access-native-projections-direct-construction`). Score `idiom_score = 3` only if `./oracle_reflect_audit` exits `0` and all three `refl01-a1..a3` checks hold; cap at `<= 1` if `FieldType.index` is passed to `get`/`set`, `is integer` replaces `reflect.inspect`, `is_public` is ignored when `all_public == true`, `Type` values are compared with `==`, or active `local` union arms crash lookup.

evals.prompt:
Implement a dynamic callable-invocation, Interface-view inspection, and native-projection library in `invoke_reflect.titan` (logical module `invoke_reflect`) using Titan's standard `reflect` and `string` modules.

Export the following public types and functions:
- `record FunctionSummary` with `const kind: string`, `const param_count: integer`, `const is_vararg: boolean`, `const return_count: integer`, and `const has_flexret: boolean`.
- `function inspect_callable(fn: value): FunctionSummary`: inspects `fn` via `reflect.inspect(fn)` (aliasing reserved keyword `type` in `case` patterns such as `when is_titan_function { signature = type }`) and returns:
  - for Titan functions: `FunctionSummary("titan", #sig.param_descriptors, sig.vararg_descriptor ~= nil, #sig.return_descriptors, sig.flexret_descriptor ~= nil)`
  - for Lua functions: `FunctionSummary("lua", meta.n_params, meta.is_vararg, 0, true)`
  - for Lua C functions: `FunctionSummary("lua_c", 0, true, 0, true)`
  - raises on non-callables.
- `function invoke_method(receiver: value, method_name: string, ...: value): (...: value)`: inspects `receiver` (`is_record`, `is_union`, or `is_interface`), searches the descriptor's public `methods` for `method_name` (raising if absent—enforcing that `local` methods are hidden), and invokes `m.callable(recv, ...)` passing `rv.value` / `uv.value` / `iv.value` (the Interface wrapper itself for Interfaces, not `iv.wrapped`) as the first argument followed by `...`.
- `function list_member_names(v: value): ({string}, {string})`: inspects `v` (`is_record`, `is_union`, or `is_interface`) and returns `(public_field_names, public_method_names)` in exact descriptor order (preserving record/union name-sorted methods and Interface declaration-order methods, omitting `local` fields/methods; unions return `{}` for fields).
- `function inspect_interface_view(iface_val: value): (string, string, {string: value})`: requires `reflect.inspect(iface_val)` to match `is_interface(iv)` (raising otherwise), reads every captured `const` field via 1-based `iv:get(i)` into `{string: value}`, separately inspects `iv.wrapped` to obtain the underlying concrete record/union nominal name, and returns `(iv.type.name, concrete_name, snapshot_fields)`.
- `function try_set_field(target: value, field_name: string, new_val: value): (boolean, string?)`:
  - If `target` is an `Interface`, returns `(false, "interface fields are read-only")`.
  - If `target` is a `Record`, locates `field_name` in public `fields[1..rv.n_fields]`; if absent (including hidden `local` fields), returns `(false, "field not found")`; otherwise attempts `rv:set(i, new_val)` inside `do ... catch` using the 1-based public ordinal `i` (never `FieldType.index`), returning `(true, nil)` on success or `(false, strings.tostring(error))` on failure (rejecting `const` fields or type mismatches while leaving prior state unchanged).
  - Otherwise returns `(false, "not a record")`.
- `function project_fields(target: value): {string: value}`: inspects record `target` (raising otherwise), calls `rv:project(i)` for every 1-based public ordinal `1..rv.n_fields`, and returns a `{string: value}` map keyed by `field.name`.
- `function root_callable(fn: value): (function(...: value): (...: value), value)`: verifies `fn` is a Titan, Lua, or Lua C function via `reflect.inspect(fn)` and returns `(callable_part, fn)` so callers retain the original `value` root alongside the dynamic callable.

assertions.check: Aliases reserved `type` in `is_titan_function`/`is_lua_function` `case` arms, passes `rv.value`/`uv.value`/`iv.value` as first arg to `MethodType.callable` with forwarded `...`, preserves descriptor ordering (sorted for records/unions vs declaration order for Interfaces), and keeps original `value` rooted in `root_callable`.

Inspects `InterfaceValue` reading captured fields via 1-based `iv:get(i)` and concrete type via `iv.wrapped`, rejects setting on Interfaces, hidden `local` fields, and `const` fields, and applies Lua-boundary conversion cleanly on mutable fields without mutating state on error.
Calls `RecordValue:project(i)` using 1-based public ordinals (omitting `local` fields and projecting native C integers/structs losslessly), and defaults `FunctionSummary` fields to `const`.

evals.judge_rubric: Canonical provenance: `titan-reflect` (`inv-2`, `inv-7`, `value-type-quick-map`, `field-access-native-projections-direct-construction`), `titan-programmer` (`inv-2`). Score `idiom_score = 3` only if `./oracle_reflect_invoke` exits `0` and all three `refl02-a1..a3` checks hold; cap at `<= 1` if `iv.wrapped` is passed to Interface `MethodType.callable` instead of `iv.value`, `FieldType.index` is used instead of 1-based ordinals, `type` keyword is not aliased in function `case` arms, `local` fields/methods leak, or `project(i)` is replaced by `get(i)`.
